test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that does NOT correctly complete the given sentence. 

During the pandemic, stray animals were at greater risk because they _______.

options.text: could resort to eating disposable masks and plastic
did not have access to waste food from restaurants
were sent to distant animal shelters

solution:
TB Solution:

The correct answer is '**were sent to distant animal shelters'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the passage, there is no mention of **stray animals being sent to distant animal shelters.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• In support of **option 1,** we find that **"Also, they are being abandoned by their owners due to unfounded fears that they may spread COVID-19."** So, it cannot be the right answer.
 
• In support of **option 2**, we find that **"****The worst possibility is that the stray animals might eat disposed masks and gloves, which can become lethal." **So, it cannot be the right answer.
 
• In support of **option 3**, we find that **"Some of the worst sufferers of the pandemic are stray animals like dogs and cats. They are no longer able to survive on waste food material from restaurants and shops because of shops being closed.****"** So, it cannot be the right answer.

 

Hence, the option that does not correctly complete the sentence is 'were sent to distant animal shelters.'
